## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: the point system
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The point values come from the guide's own example list of state law violations; the guide says the list is examples only, so no claim is made that it is complete [A01].
The guide's speeding example gives two or three points depending on court level while its list shows a single state value; both are taught side by side and not reconciled beyond the guide's words [A01].
The bureau's mailing address, street address, room number and office hours are agency contact details and were not turned into facts [A02].
Every point value, window, duration and fee was restated in original words and kept exact; no legal interpretation was added.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
